name: Org 6582
summary: Org 6582 is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) which was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: Org 6582 is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) which was never marketed.

uses.text: Org 6582 is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) which was never marketed.

fact.en: It was an early selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor from Organon that never reached the market, from the same period of research that produced fluoxetine.
fact.zh: 它是歐加農公司早期的選擇性血清素再回收抑制劑，從未上市，與氟西汀出自同一個研究時期。
fact.zhHans: 它是欧加农公司早期的选择性血清素再回收抑制剂，从未上市，与氟西汀出自同一个研究时期。
